University entrance exams (TR-YÖS, SAT etc.) are valid for two years; school-leaving exams have no expiry.
cmr29o3ss009ltnyn9aczha08.language: An English certificate is not required to apply. Prep exemption for 100% English programmes (Economics, English Translation, Business, Architecture, Political Science and IR, AI and Data Eng., Software Eng., MIS): TOEFL iBT 84, PTE Academic 71, e-TEP 80, Oxford Test 121, Linguaskill 160 or FSMEPT 70 (under 2 years old). 30% English (Psychology): TOEFL iBT 78, PTE 67, YDS/YÖKDİL 65. Otherwise the FSM proficiency exam or one year of English Preparatory (same fee as the programme).
documents: Language proficiency results — Turkish, English, Arabic (if available)
Hafiz certificate for Basic Islamic Sciences (if available)
Portfolio for Traditional Turkish Arts (and Architecture, if available)
YÖS or other national/international exam results (if available)
Notarized translation of documents not in English or Turkish

You can apply with a general high-school diploma assessed under the Ministry of National Education equivalency guide — or, instead, with one of these qualifications accepted for 2026: SAT (at least 1000 for Engineering, Architecture and Law; other programmes: submit the result), ACT 21, IB 25, at least two A levels (Cambridge system with minimum D grades) or TR-YÖS. cmr29o3su00bgtnyn0bguvfth.entry: Foreign nationals with an undergraduate degree and an undergraduate diploma GPA of at least 60/100, who have not been dismissed from a Turkish university for disciplinary reasons. ALES/GRE may be requested by the head of department (Institute of Engineering and Sciences: submit if available). Some programmes set additional language requirements; students with insufficient Arabic in Arabic-dependent programmes take 6 credits of basic Arabic per semester for two semesters.
cmr29o3su00bgtnyn0bguvfth.language: Programmes whose instruction includes Turkish: minimum C1 from Yunus Emre Institute or FSMVU TÜMER; otherwise up to one year of Turkish preparatory course at FSMVU TÜMER.
documents: Foreign language (English or Arabic) proficiency result for the relevant programme
ALES/GRE score (Institute of Engineering and Sciences, if available)
